strings.name: Anton Zeilinger
strings.summary: Anton Zeilinger explored quantum foundations and information through multiphoton entanglement, teleportation and entanglement-swapping experiments. His teams extended laboratory methods toward long-distance communication, and he helped establish Austrian quantum-research institutions. He shared the 2022 Nobel Prize in Physics with Alain Aspect and John Clauser. These achievements concern quantum states and cryptographic keys, rather than instantaneous movement of objects.
strings.coverageNote: Research checked through 13 November 2026; selected milestones extend to 2022. This is not a daily news archive. Shared achievements are credited to collaborators and teams.
strings.influence.rationale: Advanced experiments in quantum entanglement, teleportation and communication, connecting fundamental physics with emerging information technologies.
strings.facts.fact-1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.fact-2.label: Education
strings.facts.fact-2.value: Physics and mathematics studies at the University of Vienna; doctorate (1971)
strings.highlights.highlight-1.title: Teleportation and entanglement swapping
strings.highlights.highlight-1.text: His teams demonstrated photonic state teleportation and entanglement swapping, important experimental foundations for quantum networks.
strings.highlights.highlight-2.title: Long-distance communication
strings.highlights.highlight-2.text: Participated in international work extending terrestrial experiments to satellite-assisted quantum-encrypted communication.
strings.timeline.event-1.title: Shared Nobel Prize in Physics
strings.timeline.event-1.text: Honored with Aspect and Clauser for entangled-photon experiments and quantum-information science.
strings.timeline.event-2.title: Intercontinental quantum-encrypted call
strings.timeline.event-2.text: His team helped use satellite-assisted key distribution for an encrypted video call between Vienna and Beijing.
strings.timeline.event-3.title: Led the Austrian Academy
strings.timeline.event-3.text: Began a presidency of the Austrian Academy of Sciences that continued through2022.
strings.timeline.event-4.title: Co-founded quantum institute
strings.timeline.event-4.text: Helped establish the Academy's Institute for Quantum Optics and Quantum Information.
strings.timeline.event-5.title: University of Vienna appointment
strings.timeline.event-5.text: Moved from Innsbruck to Vienna to continue experiments on quantum foundations and information.
strings.timeline.event-6.title: Entanglement swapping
strings.timeline.event-6.text: With collaborators transferred entanglement to another particle pair, extending the experimental tools for quantum networks.
strings.timeline.event-7.title: Photonic quantum teleportation
strings.timeline.event-7.text: The team transferred a photon's quantum state using shared entanglement and classical communication.
strings.timeline.event-8.title: Vienna doctorate
strings.timeline.event-8.text: Completed doctoral research at the University of Vienna before further work on neutron experiments.
strings.timeline.event-9.title: Born in Austria
strings.timeline.event-9.text: Born in Ried im Innkreis, Upper Austria.
